completion_summary: Added three new four-way closed TFAE theorems (cplProofSystemsWithAlgebraTfae, iplProofSystemsWithAlgebraTfae, mplProofSystemsWithAlgebraTfae) to Cslib/Logics/Propositional/ProofSystemEquivalence.lean, folding algebraic semantic validity (BAValid, HAValid, GHAValid) onto the existing closed three-way TFAE families for CPL, IPL, and MPL, via a single new public import and one new section. The full CSLib CI pipeline is green end-to-end: lake build (3325/3325), checkInitImports, lake lint, lint-style, lake test, shake, and mk_all all pass. Zero new sorries, axioms unchanged at [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], and the nine pre-existing TFAE theorem statements are byte-identical to their pre-change form. The one blocker from the prior dispatch (lake test failing on CslibTests.GrindLint due to an out-of-territory sibling-task regression in Cslib/Logics/Bimodal and Cslib/Logics/Temporal) was resolved by the owning sibling task adding four missing #grind_lint skip entries; re-verified green.
